export_format: PyTorch checkpoint downloaded lazily; ONNX export not yet validated
normalization: Ultralytics YOLO preprocessing (RGB, letterbox, 0–1 tensor scaling)

preprocessing.high_resolution: overlapping 1536 px tiles at 192 px overlap by default; coordinates restored by tile offsets

thresholds: configs/thresholds.json; candidate confidence floor is 0.05 and lower-confidence candidates remain in review output
segmentation: Instance masks converted to polygon contours; duplicate candidates merged with same-class bounding-box IoU NMS at 0.65
coordinate_conventions: origin top-left; x right; y down; polygon vertices [x,y]; bbox [x,y,width,height]; coordinates refer to original EXIF-oriented raster pixels

devices: cuda with compatible PyTorch and driver
runtime.fallback: auto chooses CUDA if available, otherwise CPU
